one_liner.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供跨会话持久知识记录与检索工具。
one_liner.en: Persistent cross-session knowledge storage and retrieval tools for DSH agents.

local: Requires Node.js >=22.5 for node:sqlite; creates a SQLite database under XDG data home or ~/.local/share/dsh-knowledge-graph/knowledge.db.

install.command: git clone https://github.com/fango19961106-dotcom/dsh-knowledge-graph; copy the plugin into ~/.dsh/plugins and add it to the profile cordis.patch.yml

config_items.name: XDG_DATA_HOME
config_items.description: Overrides the base directory for the SQLite database.

completeness.reason: Store implements remember, full-text search, and recent retrieval.

code.reason: Typed store and tool registration are separated into focused modules.

docs.reason: README documents installation, tool contracts, and usage examples.

maintenance.reason: Facts record one commit and an August 2026 push.

tests.reason: A smoke test covers storage, search, persistence, and tool registration; no CI is recorded.

quality.notes: Scores are conservative; maintenance reflects one recorded commit.
